list.title: Events
list.intro: Conferences, meetings and courses, from Med Connect and from organisations.

event.timeNote: Times are shown in Israel time.
event.readAtSource: See the event at its source
event.noSessions: The programme hasn’t been published yet.

registration.title: Registration
registration.waiting: You are number {position} on the waiting list. We will email you if a place opens.
registration.placesLeft: {count, plural, one {# place left} other {# places left}}
registration.full: The event is full. You can join the waiting list.

schedule.hint: Tick the sessions you plan to attend.

checkIn.title: Attendance
checkIn.missing: This page opens from the code shown at the venue. Please scan the code again.

schedule.title: My schedule
schedule.intro: The events you registered for and the sessions you chose.
schedule.empty: You haven’t registered for any event yet.
schedule.download: Download my schedule as a calendar file

editor.summaryHint: One or two sentences, shown in the events list and in calendar files.
editor.coordinatesHint: Optional, for the map link. Give both or neither.
editor.capacityHint: Leave empty for no limit. When full, people join a waiting list.
editor.cme: CME is available for this event
editor.types: Membership types that can see it
editor.cancelHint: Shown on the event and emailed to everyone who registered.
editor.cancelledNotice: This event was cancelled and can no longer be changed.
editor.changeNotice: Changing the time or the place emails everyone who registered.

sessions.title: Programme
sessions.needsDates: Save the event with its start and end before adding sessions.
sessions.noSpeakers: No speakers yet. Add them on the Speakers page.
sessions.materialHint: PDF, Word or PowerPoint, up to 25 MB.
sessions.titleRequired: Give a title in at least one language.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.summary: {count, plural, one {# person attended} other {# people attended}}
attendance.codeHint: Show this code at the venue. Members scan it with their phone’s camera. It renews itself every few minutes.
attendance.notPublished: Attendance is recorded only for a published event.

speakers.title: Speakers
speakers.intro: Speakers are shared between events. In the demo, use fictional names only.
speakers.nameRequired: Give a name in at least one language.

categories.title: Event categories
categories.intro: Categories are hidden rather than deleted, so older events keep theirs.
categories.keyHint: Lowercase English letters, digits and underscores, for example annual_meeting.

conference.title: Conference mode
conference.guestExplain: A QR code lets people in as guests, with a number and no details, only to this event. It exists only on a demo.
conference.startExplain: Moves the sessions so that one is on now, opens the guest entry, and clears votes, questions, feedback and guests left from the last time.
conference.startConfirm: Clear what was left here and start the demonstration now?
conference.staffExplain: Accounts' email addresses, separated by commas. A chair also moderates; each is only for their session. Whoever manages the event may do both everywhere in it.

live.title: Live session
live.notLive: The live connection is away. This page asks for news every 15 seconds.
live.pollDraft: Not open yet. Only the chair sees this.
live.votesAnonymous: Votes are anonymous: nobody can see how you voted.
live.noPatients: Please do not include anything that could identify a patient.
live.sentForModeration: Your question was sent. A moderator reads it before the hall sees it.
live.questionsClosed: This session is not taking questions now.
live.feedbackAnonymous: Feedback is anonymous: nothing links it to you.
live.moderateFirst: A moderator reads each question before the hall sees it
live.feedbackResult: Average {average} of 5, from {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}.

guest.title: Enter the conference
guest.explain: You come in as a guest, under a number. No name, email or password. You can vote, ask questions and give feedback in this conference, and nothing else.
guest.noCode: This link has no code. Scan the code again.
guest.alreadySignedIn: You're already signed in. Go to the event
guest.demoNotice: This is a demonstration version, with made-up details.
